concept.subject: Science
concept.title: How plants make food
concept.recall: Plants use sunlight, water and air to make sugar in their leaves.
concept.example: A leaf in sunlight makes food.

concept.subject: History
concept.title: Causes of the First World War
concept.recall: Alliances, militarism, imperialism and nationalism turned a local crisis into a world war.
concept.example: The assassination in Sarajevo pulled allies into war.
concept.nonExample: The war started because of one speech.

asked: List the four main causes of the First World War.
input.evidence: Recalls the causes but mixes up which alliance each country was in.

concept.subject: Reading
concept.title: The prefix un-
concept.recall: Un- at the start of a word means not or the opposite.
concept.nonExample: Under is not un- plus der.

concept.subject: Math
concept.title: Percent of a number
concept.recall: To find a percent of a number, write the percent as a fraction of 100 and multiply.

concept.subject: Geography
concept.title: Reading a map scale
concept.recall: A map scale tells how far a distance on the map is in real life.
concept.example: 1 cm on the map is 10 km.
concept.nonExample: Bigger maps always show bigger places.

input.evidence: Solid at measuring with the scale.

concept.subject: Reading
concept.title: Finding the main idea
concept.recall: The main idea is what most of the paragraph is about, not one detail.
concept.example: A paragraph about bee jobs: bees have many jobs in a hive.
concept.nonExample: The main idea is the first sentence, always.
